judgments.affected_condition: Printed text: “(“Eligible Investment Transactions”).” followed by the separate heading “7. Product Category”. The right extraction changes the closing double quotation mark to a single quotation mark and omits the printed section number “7.”. The quotation-mark difference is typographic; the missing section number is an omission of text identifying the Product Category provisions, which paragraph 6 expressly references. This does not itself establish a change in legal applicability.

Printed text: “7.1 Intermediaries should devise (or adjust as appropriate) Product Categories to categorise investment products based on the terms and features, characteristics, nature and extent of risks of investment product.” The right extraction omits the clearly printed paragraph identifier “7.1”. This is a text omission affecting paragraph identification, rather than a typographic variation; the listed difference does not change the requirement’s wording.

Printed opening: “7.2 The SPI should specify the Product Categories within which investment transactions could be executed under a Streamlined Approach.” The right extraction omits the clearly printed paragraph identifier “7.2”. This is a text omission affecting identification of the paragraph containing category selection, documentation, information-statement, applicable warning and requested-explanation provisions. The listed difference does not omit those provisions themselves.

Printed text: “7.3 Intermediaries should not apply the Streamlined Approach to investment transactions within a Product Category for an SPI unless –”. The right extraction omits the clearly printed paragraph identifier “7.3”. This is a text omission affecting identification of the condition introducing alternatives (a) and (b), rather than a typographic variation. The listed difference does not remove “unless” or alter the alternatives.

Printed text: “within a Product Category for an SPI unless –”, followed by separately indented alternatives (a) and (b), connected by “or”. The printed dash appears to be an en dash; the right extraction substitutes an em dash. This is a typographic difference in the punctuation introducing the alternatives. Neither the condition nor its alternative structure changes.

Printed heading: “8. Streamlining Threshold”. The right extraction omits the clearly printed section number “8.”. This is a text omission affecting identification of the threshold provisions, which paragraph 6 expressly references, rather than a typographic variation. The heading’s words remain unchanged in the listed difference.

Printed text: “8.1 The SPI should specify a maximum threshold of investment, as an absolute amount or a percentage relative to the SPI’s assets under management (“AUM”) with the intermediary, that is acceptable to be executed under a Streamlined Approach (“Streamlining Threshold”).” The right extraction omits the clearly printed paragraph identifier “8.1”. This is a text omission affecting paragraph identification. The listed difference does not alter the absolute-amount or percentage alternatives or the stated AUM basis.

Printed text: “8.2 SPI could specify a Streamlining Threshold appropriate to their circumstances and the intermediary is required to maintain proper records of setting any such threshold, including the SPI’s rationale that provides support for setting such threshold.” The right extraction omits the clearly printed paragraph identifier “8.2”. This is a text omission affecting paragraph identification, rather than a typographic variation. The listed difference does not alter the circumstances, recordkeeping or supporting-rationale wording.
